name: Good Food Fund
summary: Promotes plant-rich diets and food system change in China through a cooking network (Mama's Kitchen), an annual Good Food Summit and a youth leadership program. ACE did not estimate suffering averted for Good Food Fund because the inputs would be too speculative; this model uses the reach figures ACE reports and ranks them through the shared exchange rates for animals spared per person reached and SADs per animal spared.

sections.title: Bottom line
sections.explainer: People reached per dollar across the three programs. Reach says nothing by itself about how many meals or animals are affected, which is why ACE didn't convert it into suffering averted. To rank it, the shared assumptions convert people reached into animals spared and then into SADs; those rates, not this model, carry that judgment.

sections.title: Your dollar's share
sections.explainer: charityevals adjustments on top of ACE's figures.

sections.title: From people reached to animals spared (ours)
sections.explainer: charityevals' bridge, not ACE's. ACE stops at people reached per dollar and says turning reach into animals spared would be too speculative. To rank Good Food Fund at all, we make that guess here, with a wide range; it carries most of the uncertainty in this model.

sections.title: In chicken pain days
sections.explainer: charityevals' standard step for every animal model, not ACE's. Ambitious Impact's suffering-adjusted days (SADs) count each species' pain as a share of a person's, using its own species weights. Here those weights come out and Rethink Priorities' estimates go in, so every species is counted in days of a chicken's disabling pain. How a chicken's suffering compares with a person's is the one animal slider, under Your values.

source.title: ACE's 2016 Guesstimate models (leaflets, pledges, social media)

rows.explainer:
How many farmed animals reaching one person spares, allowing for lapsing: about 84% of new vegetarians go back.

ACE's reference points: about 0.02 animals per video watched, 1 per leaflet, 6 per week-long vegan pledge. The default mixes these by Good Food Fund's reach: online views counted like videos, its cooking network like leaflets.

rows.label: Animals spared per dollar you give
SADs averted per animal spared
rows.explainer: The shared figures for a replaced meal, in suffering-adjusted days (SADs) and in animals, give the suffering behind each animal spared: about 8.7 SADs. Every model that counts animals spared uses this one rate, split by species below.

rows.label: SADs averted per dollar you give: fish
rows.explainer: SADs averted for fish per dollar you give: animals spared times the SADs behind each, split by ACE's global estimate of which animals a replaced meal spares (Share of a replaced meal's suffering, under Data).

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: fish
rows.explainer: The SADs for fish with the fish weight built into the 2024 SADs ACE used (about 27% of a person's) taken out, and Rethink Priorities' estimate of how much fish can suffer relative to a chicken put in. The evaluator view keeps Ambitious Impact's weights, so ACE's own result reproduces.

rows.label: SADs averted per dollar you give: chickens
rows.explainer: SADs averted for chickens per dollar you give: animals spared times the SADs behind each, split by ACE's global estimate of which animals a replaced meal spares (Share of a replaced meal's suffering, under Data).

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: chickens
rows.explainer: The SADs for chickens with the hen weight built into the 2024 SADs ACE used (46% of a person's) taken out, which leaves days of a chicken's disabling pain. A chicken counts as 1 here by definition; how a chicken's suffering compares with a person's is the chicken slider. The evaluator view keeps Ambitious Impact's weight, so ACE's own result reproduces.

rows.label: SADs averted per dollar you give: pigs
rows.explainer: SADs averted for pigs per dollar you give: animals spared times the SADs behind each, split by ACE's global estimate of which animals a replaced meal spares (Share of a replaced meal's suffering, under Data).

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: pigs
rows.explainer: The SADs for pigs with the pig weight built into the 2024 SADs ACE used (63% of a person's) taken out, and Rethink Priorities' estimate of how much pigs can suffer relative to a chicken put in. The evaluator view keeps Ambitious Impact's weights, so ACE's own result reproduces.

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
rows.explainer: Days of disabling pain spared, all species, counted as a chicken's. The headline converts this into years of healthy life with the chicken slider and the healthy hours lost per day of disabling pain.
